description: This file contains unit tests for the EmployeeTrackerAPI class within the OrangeHRM Performance plugin. It includes test methods for API operations like getAll, getOne, create, update, and delete, and uses data providers for parameterized tests. The tests check API responses and validation rules, leveraging mock services and fixture data.
